intro: Hinott's Assistance is an urgent journey undertaken by Horde rogues suffering from a debilitating tropical toxin. Contracted during an infiltration mission in the Barrens, the affliction requires the specialized expertise of Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill. Seeking his aid promises both a life-saving cure and instruction in the art of concocting deadly poisons.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take a sample of the mixture to Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill.
If anyone can cure you, it's Serge. Live long enough and Serge will show you the ways of poison creation and use.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You look deliciously pale, adventurer. And what is that foul aroma you are giving off? I must know!
